## Blog posts
- [DhanPlan: a retirement calculator that speaks Indian finance](https://saswatasg.com/blog/dhanplan-retirement-calculator): Building a calculator where SIP/EPF/PPF/NPS and FIRE are first-class citizens — product choices from projections to inflation. Design, scope, and tests.
- [20+ discovery calls to a top-3 roadmap brief](https://saswatasg.com/blog/discovery-to-roadmap): At Upcore I hunted 20+ prospects across 12 verticals; the output was a prioritized opportunity brief. The method behind turning interviews into a roadmap.
- [Simplest e-commerce CRO: ship one fix a week](https://saswatasg.com/blog/one-fix-a-week-cro): A handful of heartfelt, repeatable wins — checkout trust, search weights, PDP details — each small, each measured. The cadence beats the splash.
- [What an AI-era product manager does all day](https://saswatasg.com/blog/ai-era-product-manager): AI didn't remove the PM job — it moved the work up the judgment ladder. Specs get faster; decisions, scope, and risk reign. Real before/after inside.
- [The data deep-dive: 480K sessions to three real problems](https://saswatasg.com/blog/data-deep-dive-method): The repeatable method I used across checkout, category pages, and forms: instrument first, form hypotheses second, never optimize an unmeasured funnel.
- [Topshe: voice AI that runs entirely in your browser](https://saswatasg.com/blog/topshe-browser-voice-ai): Wake word, speech-to-text, and a quantised Qwen 2.5 model in-browser via WebAssembly — no server, no API bill, no data left your device.
- [FilmRisk.AI: scoring film risk with ML and Bayesian priors](https://saswatasg.com/blog/film-risk-engine): A 2,200-film dataset, gradient-boosted ML plus Bayesian priors, and a scoring engine that backtests itself. I built FilmRisk.AI — the failures included.
- [Daily report automation: 3 sources, 88 rows, 11 AM](https://saswatasg.com/blog/daily-report-automation): A Google Apps Script pipeline unifying Kibana, MongoDB, and GA4 into one auto-populated report — and what white-collar automation really costs.
- [AI image greetings lifted feature engagement by 168%](https://saswatasg.com/blog/ai-send-greetings-168): A dormant 'Send Greetings' feature, an image-gen model, and a festival calendar across 27 occasions — feature engagement up 168%.
- [The 17:1 e-way bill gap: diagnosing B2B adoption](https://saswatasg.com/blog/e-invoice-adoption-gap): Why PRO+ users generated bills in Tally, not in-app — a two-week diagnostic that uncovered a 17:1 gap and changed the roadmap at C-suite level.
- [Gold/silver/bronze lead routing that cut days to close](https://saswatasg.com/blog/lead-routing-gold-silver-bronze): Website forms at 63.5% CVR but chat at 4.7%? We built a lead scoring router that sends gold leads to humans and bronze to automation.
- [27 push notification triggers, 5 regions, one architecture](https://saswatasg.com/blog/push-notification-architecture): Designing a notification system across renewals, transactional states, and conflict logic — with priority tiers and a daily cap users don't hate.
- [Category page redesign that added +34% qualified leads](https://saswatasg.com/blog/category-page-redesign-plus34): A 4-week sprint on GA4 custom events and Clarity heatmaps turned story-led category journeys into +17% PDP clicks, +34% leads, −16% bounce.
- [How I built an AI recruiter agent for LinkedIn outreach](https://saswatasg.com/blog/ai-recruiter-agent-build): 766 commits, 6 releases, one self-hosted macOS app. The honest design and failure modes of an AI recruiter agent — research and intros, not spam.
- [How a form fix lifted lead submissions by 124% in 28 days](https://saswatasg.com/blog/lead-form-overhaul-124): A field-by-field form teardown with GA4 events and Clarity — one field caused 23% of drop-offs. The fix raised lead submissions 124% in 28 days.
- [How we cut checkout abandonment from 73.1% to 53.9%](https://saswatasg.com/blog/checkout-abandonment-73-to-54): A 480K-session teardown: three separate checkout problems, three targeted fixes, two sprints — and a 26% relative drop in cart abandonment.
